scope: All8 public cases completed both complete4834frame Dev and15985frame seven-sequence Test. Four already published ByteTrack cases are references; no new GPU/detector/IR generation. One fixed default parameter set per public tracker, not a tuned best-of-method reproduction. RGB uses its original priority policy; IR/gray use their own original Dev-selected raw policies. SORT/OC-SORT API supplies no confidence, so emitted MOT confidence is1 and unused in evaluation. CPU tracker/replay costs exclude detector/fusion and cannot be called end-to-end FPS.
limitations: Historical Test already exposed; no new blind-test claim.
Source RGB pretraining saw the current Dev; pseudoIR derives from RGB.
SORT max_age1 and OC-SORT max_age30 are their fixed defaults, not matched lifecycle tuning.
These backend comparisons do not replace multimodal module removal/wrong/missing controls.
Shared CPU host; measured cached tracker rates are not isolated or end-to-end rates.
